problem.title: 动态数组

en.title: Dynamic Array
en.description:
Implement a dynamic array `DynamicArray` on **fixed-size** storage only: once allocated, a block never changes length (Python `[0] * cap`, C++ `new int[cap]`, Java `new int[cap]`, Go `make([]int, cap)` and never `append`). To grow or shrink, allocate a new block and move the elements over one by one.

Capacity rules (the `capacity` operation checks them):

- The capacity starts at 1 and the length at 0.
- When `push` or `insert` finds the length equal to the capacity, **double** the capacity first, then place the new element.
- After `pop` or `erase` removes an element, if the capacity is greater than 1 and the length is at most a quarter of it (`size * 4 <= capacity`), **halve** the capacity once.

Methods to implement:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `push(x)` | Append x |
| `pop()` | Remove and return the last element |
| `get(i)` / `set(i, x)` | Read / write the element at index i (0-based) |
| `insert(i, x)` | Insert x at index i, shifting i and later elements right (`0 <= i <= size`) |
| `erase(i)` | Remove and return the element at index i, shifting later elements left |
| `size()` / `capacity()` | Current length / current capacity |

The starter code already has a driver that reads the input, calls your methods and prints the results; fill in the class.
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

push x / pop / get i / set i x / insert i x / erase i / size / capacity

Every operation is valid: the array is non-empty for pop and erase, and every index is in range.

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, |x| ≤ 10^9. There are at most 2000 insert and erase operations in total, and the array holds at most 1000 elements when they run.
en.output: Each `pop`, `get`, `erase`, `size` and `capacity` prints one line: the removed or read element, the length or the capacity.
en.explanation: After push 5 and push 7 the capacity has gone from 1 to 2; push 9 finds length 2 equal to the capacity and doubles it to 4. insert 1 3 gives [5, 3, 7, 9], so get 1 reads 3. erase 0 removes 5 and pop removes 9, leaving [3, 7] of length 2. Two more pops follow: with one element left, 1×4 ≤ 4 halves the capacity to 2; once empty, 0×4 ≤ 2 halves it again to 1.
hints: push is insert(size, x) and pop is erase(size - 1), so the grow and shrink logic is written once.
Shift right starting from the last element, or you overwrite values not yet moved; shift left from the front.
Why shrink at a quarter rather than at half? Picture capacity 4 with the length bouncing between 2 and 3 through push and pop.

problem.description:
只用**定长**存储实现一个动态数组 `DynamicArray`：存储一旦分配就不再改变长度（Python 用 `[0] * cap` 创建，C++ 用 `new int[cap]`，Java 用 `new int[cap]`，Go 用 `make([]int, cap)` 且不再 `append`），需要扩容或缩容时申请一块新存储，把元素逐个搬过去。

容量规则（会被 `capacity` 操作检查）：

- 初始容量为 1，长度为 0。
- `push` 或 `insert` 时如果长度已经等于容量，先把容量**翻倍**，再放入新元素。
- `pop` 或 `erase` 删除元素之后，如果容量大于 1 并且长度不超过容量的四分之一（`size * 4 <= capacity`），把容量**减半**一次。

需要实现的方法：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `push(x)` | 在末尾追加 x |
| `pop()` | 删除并返回最后一个元素 |
| `get(i)` / `set(i, x)` | 读 / 写下标 i（从 0 开始）的元素 |
| `insert(i, x)` | 把 x 插到下标 i，原来 i 及之后的元素后移一位（`0 <= i <= size`） |
| `erase(i)` | 删除并返回下标 i 的元素，之后的元素前移一位 |
| `size()` / `capacity()` | 当前长度 / 当前容量 |

起始代码已经写好了读输入、调用方法、打印结果的驱动，只需补全类里的方法。
problem.input:
第一行是操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

push x / pop / get i / set i x / insert i x / erase i / size / capacity

数据保证每个操作都合法：pop 和 erase 时数组非空，下标都在范围内。

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，|x| ≤ 10^9。insert 与 erase 合计不超过 2000 次，执行它们时数组长度不超过 1000。
problem.output: `pop`、`get`、`erase`、`size`、`capacity` 各输出一行：被删除或读到的元素、长度或容量。
problem.explanation: push 5、push 7 后容量从 1 变 2；再 push 9 时长度 2 等于容量，容量翻倍成 4。insert 1 3 后数组是 [5, 3, 7, 9]，get 1 读到 3。erase 0 删掉 5，pop 删掉 9，剩 [3, 7]，长度 2。之后 pop 两次：剩 1 个元素时 1×4 ≤ 4，容量减半为 2；数组变空时 0×4 ≤ 2，容量再减半为 1。
hints: push 可以写成 insert(size, x)，pop 可以写成 erase(size - 1)，扩容和缩容的逻辑只写一遍。
后移元素要从最后一个开始往前搬，否则会覆盖还没搬的值；前移则从前往后搬。
为什么缩容要等到四分之一而不是一半？试想容量为 4、长度在 2 和 3 之间来回 push / pop 时会发生什么。

problem.title: 单链表

en.title: Singly Linked List
en.description:
Implement a singly linked list `LinkedList` with nodes and pointers; no built-in list, array or linked-list container may hold the elements. The starter code defines the node. The list keeps a `head` pointer, a `tail` pointer and its length, so `push_back` is O(1) too.

Methods to implement:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `push_front(x)` / `push_back(x)` | Add x at the front / back |
| `pop_front()` | Remove the head node and return its value (the list is non-empty) |
| `insert(i, x)` | Make x the node at position i (0-based, `0 <= i <= size`) |
| `remove(x)` | Remove the first node whose value is x; return true if one was removed, false otherwise |
| `reverse()` | Reverse the list in place (relink nodes, create none) |
| `size()` | Number of nodes |
| `values()` | All values from head to tail, for the driver to print |

Method names follow each language's conventions (Java `pushFront`, Go `PushFront`); the starter code has them. After removing the last node or reversing, make sure `tail` points at the new last node.
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

push_front x / push_back x / pop_front / insert i x / remove x / reverse / size / print

The list is non-empty for every pop_front, and every insert index is in range.

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, |x| ≤ 10^9. There are at most 200 insert, remove, reverse and print operations in total, and at most 20 prints.
en.output: `pop_front` prints the removed value; `remove` prints 1 if it removed a node and 0 otherwise; `size` prints the length; `print` prints every value from head to tail on one line, separated by spaces, or empty for an empty list.
en.explanation: The pushes build 1 → 2 → 3 and insert 1 9 gives 1 → 9 → 2 → 3. remove 2 succeeds and remove 7 finds nothing. Reversing gives 3 → 9 → 1, and pop_front removes 3.
hints: A sentinel node before the head, holding no value, spares insert and remove a special case for changing the head.
Reverse with three pointers: previous, current and next. At each step save next first, then point the current node back.
When remove deletes the last node, tail must step back to the node before it; when the list becomes empty, clear both head and tail.

problem.description:
用节点和指针实现一个单链表 `LinkedList`，不能用语言自带的列表、数组或链表容器存元素。起始代码给出了节点结构；链表同时维护头指针 `head`、尾指针 `tail` 和长度，使 `push_back` 也是 O(1)。

需要实现的方法：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `push_front(x)` / `push_back(x)` | 在头部 / 尾部加入 x |
| `pop_front()` | 删除并返回头节点的值（调用时链表非空） |
| `insert(i, x)` | 让 x 成为第 i 个节点（从 0 开始，`0 <= i <= size`） |
| `remove(x)` | 删除第一个值为 x 的节点，删除了返回真，没找到返回假 |
| `reverse()` | 原地反转链表（只改指针，不新建节点） |
| `size()` | 节点个数 |
| `values()` | 从头到尾的所有值，供驱动打印 |

方法名按各语言的惯例书写（如 Java 的 `pushFront`、Go 的 `PushFront`），以起始代码为准。删除尾节点、反转之后，都要记得让 `tail` 指向新的最后一个节点。
problem.input:
第一行是操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

push_front x / push_back x / pop_front / insert i x / remove x / reverse / size / print

数据保证 pop_front 时链表非空，insert 的下标在范围内。

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，|x| ≤ 10^9。insert、remove、reverse、print 合计不超过 200 次，print 不超过 20 次。
problem.output: `pop_front` 输出被删除的值；`remove` 删除成功输出 1，否则输出 0；`size` 输出长度；`print` 在一行内从头到尾输出所有值（以空格分隔），链表为空时输出 empty。
problem.explanation: 依次加入后链表是 1 → 2 → 3，insert 1 9 得到 1 → 9 → 2 → 3。remove 2 成功，remove 7 找不到。reverse 后是 3 → 9 → 1，pop_front 删掉 3。
hints: 在头部之前放一个不存值的哨兵节点，可以让 insert 和 remove 不必单独处理「改的是头节点」的情况。
反转时用三个指针：上一个、当前、下一个。每一步先记下 next，再把当前节点的 next 指回去。
remove 删掉的如果是最后一个节点，tail 要退回到它的前一个节点；链表删空时 head 和 tail 都要清空。

problem.title: 双端队列（环形缓冲区）

en.title: Double-Ended Queue (Ring Buffer)
en.description:
Implement a double-ended queue `RingDeque` on a ring buffer: adding and removing at both ends and reading by index are all O(1) (amortized over growth). No built-in deque may be used (Python `collections.deque`, C++ `std::deque`, Java `ArrayDeque`).

The idea: a fixed-size array `data`, a head index `head` and a length `size`. Element i (0-based) lives at `data[(head + i) % capacity]`.

- The capacity starts at 4. When adding to a full array, first allocate one twice as large, move the elements over **in queue order** to positions 0, 1, 2, … and reset `head` to 0.
- `push_front` steps `head` back one slot (wrapping from 0 to the end); `push_back` writes the slot after the tail.

Methods to implement:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `push_front(x)` / `push_back(x)` | Add x at the front / back |
| `pop_front()` / `pop_back()` | Remove and return the front / back element |
| `front()` / `back()` | Return the front / back element |
| `get(i)` | Return element i counting from the front (0-based) |
| `size()` | Number of elements |

The driver calls `pop_*`, `front` and `back` only on a non-empty queue and prints empty itself otherwise. Method names follow each language's conventions (Java `pushFront`, Go `PushFront`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

push_front x / push_back x / pop_front / pop_back / front / back / get i / size

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, |x| ≤ 10^9, and every get index is in range.
en.output: `pop_front`, `pop_back`, `front`, `back` and `get` print the element, or empty when the queue is empty (get never meets an empty queue); `size` prints the number of elements.
en.explanation: After push_back 1, push_back 2 and push_front 3 the queue reads 3 1 2 from front to back, and head has wrapped to the end of the array. get 0 is 3 and get 2 is 2. push_front 4 takes the last free slot; push_back 5 finds the array full, so it grows to 8 holding 4 3 1 2 5. The pops then empty it, and a final pop_back on the empty queue prints empty.
hints: Step back as (head - 1 + capacity) % capacity: in some languages a negative number modulo stays negative.
Growing cannot copy data in its physical order: the queue may start mid-array and wrap past the end to the beginning.
Removing needs no clearing of the slot; just move head or shrink size.

problem.description:
用环形缓冲区实现双端队列 `RingDeque`，两端的加入和删除、按下标读取都是 O(1)（扩容摊还）。不能用语言自带的双端队列（Python 的 `collections.deque`、C++ 的 `std::deque`、Java 的 `ArrayDeque`）。

做法：一块定长数组 `data`、队头下标 `head` 和长度 `size`。第 i 个元素（从 0 开始）存在 `data[(head + i) % capacity]`。

- 初始容量为 4。加入元素时如果数组已满，先申请两倍大的数组，把元素**按队列顺序**搬到新数组的 0、1、2……位置，`head` 归零。
- `push_front` 让 `head` 向前退一格（退到 0 之前就绕回末尾），`push_back` 写到队尾之后的那一格。

需要实现的方法：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `push_front(x)` / `push_back(x)` | 在队头 / 队尾加入 x |
| `pop_front()` / `pop_back()` | 删除并返回队头 / 队尾元素 |
| `front()` / `back()` | 返回队头 / 队尾元素 |
| `get(i)` | 返回从队头数第 i 个元素（从 0 开始） |
| `size()` | 元素个数 |

驱动只在队列非空时调用 `pop_*`、`front`、`back`；队列为空时由驱动直接输出 empty。方法名按各语言的惯例书写（如 Java 的 `pushFront`、Go 的 `PushFront`），以起始代码为准。
problem.input:
第一行是操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

push_front x / push_back x / pop_front / pop_back / front / back / get i / size

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，|x| ≤ 10^9，get 的下标一定在范围内。
problem.output: `pop_front`、`pop_back`、`front`、`back`、`get` 输出对应的元素，队列为空时输出 empty（get 不会遇到空队列）；`size` 输出元素个数。
problem.explanation: push_back 1、push_back 2、push_front 3 之后，队列从头到尾是 3 1 2，此时 head 已经绕到了数组末尾。get 0 是 3，get 2 是 2。push_front 4 用掉最后一个空位；push_back 5 时数组已满，扩容到 8，队列是 4 3 1 2 5。之后依次弹出，最后对空队列 pop_back 输出 empty。
hints: 下标往前退时写成 (head - 1 + capacity) % capacity，避免某些语言里负数取模得到负数。
扩容时不能直接按 data 的物理顺序复制：队列可能从数组中间开始、绕过末尾接到开头。
删除元素时不必清空那一格，只要移动 head 或减小 size。

problem.title: 哈希表（拉链法）

en.title: Hash Map (Separate Chaining)
en.description:
Implement an integer-to-integer hash map `HashMap` with separate chaining: an array of buckets, each a linked list or small array of (key, value) pairs, with a hash function sending each key to a bucket. No built-in hash or ordered map may be used (`dict`, `set`, `unordered_map`, `map`, `HashMap`, `TreeMap`, Go's `map`).

The bucket count (the `buckets` operation checks it):

- It starts at 8.
- After a `put` adds a new key (updating an existing key does not count), if `size * 4 > buckets * 3`, that is the load factor exceeds 0.75, **double** the bucket count and redistribute every pair into the new buckets.
- Removals never reduce the bucket count.

Any hash function will do, as long as the bucket index lands in `[0, buckets)`.

Methods to implement:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `put(key, value)` | Add the key, or update its value if present |
| `get(key)` | Return the key's value, or -1 if absent |
| `remove(key)` | Remove the key; return true if it was present, false otherwise |
| `size()` | Number of pairs |
| `buckets()` | Current bucket count |
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

put k v / get k / remove k / size / buckets

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, |k| ≤ 10^9, 0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9.
en.output: `get` prints the value or -1; `remove` prints 1 if it removed the key and 0 otherwise; `size` prints the number of pairs; `buckets` prints the bucket count.
en.explanation: The first 6 puts add 6 distinct keys. After the 7th new key, put 70 7, size is 7 and 7×4 = 28 > 8×3 = 24, so the buckets double to 16. put 10 100 only updates a value and leaves size alone. remove 20 succeeds, the second remove 20 fails, and get 20 gives -1.
hints: Keys may be negative. In languages where a negative number modulo stays negative, such as Java and C++, make the hash non-negative first.

With key % buckets and a power-of-two bucket count, every multiple of 1024 lands in the same bucket while there are at most 1024 buckets. Multiplying the key by a large odd constant (such as 2654435761) before taking the remainder spreads keys far more evenly.
When growing, recompute every pair's index for the new bucket count; old buckets cannot be copied over as they are.

problem.description:
用拉链法实现整数到整数的哈希表 `HashMap`：一个桶数组，每个桶是一条存放 (键, 值) 的链表或小数组，键经过哈希函数落到某个桶里。不能用语言自带的哈希表或有序表（`dict`、`set`、`unordered_map`、`map`、`HashMap`、`TreeMap`、Go 的 `map`）。

桶的数量（会被 `buckets` 操作检查）：

- 初始为 8 个桶。
- `put` 新增了一个键之后（更新已有键的值不算），如果 `size * 4 > buckets * 3`，也就是负载因子超过 0.75，桶数**翻倍**，并把所有键值对重新分配到新的桶里。
- 删除不会让桶数变少。

哈希函数自选，只要桶下标落在 `[0, buckets)` 内。

需要实现的方法：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `put(key, value)` | 键不存在就新增，存在就更新值 |
| `get(key)` | 返回键对应的值，键不存在返回 -1 |
| `remove(key)` | 删除键，删除了返回真，键不存在返回假 |
| `size()` | 键值对个数 |
| `buckets()` | 当前桶数 |
problem.input:
第一行是操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

put k v / get k / remove k / size / buckets

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，|k| ≤ 10^9，0 ≤ v ≤ 10^9。
problem.output: `get` 输出值或 -1；`remove` 删除成功输出 1，否则输出 0；`size` 输出键值对个数；`buckets` 输出桶数。
problem.explanation: 前 6 次 put 加入 6 个不同的键：第 7 个新键 put 70 7 之后 size 为 7，7×4 = 28 > 8×3 = 24，桶数翻倍成 16。put 10 100 只是更新值，size 不变。remove 20 成功，再次 remove 20 失败；get 20 得到 -1。
hints: 键可能为负数。像 Java、C++ 这样负数取模会得到负数的语言，要先把哈希值转成非负数。
如果直接用 key % buckets，而桶数总是 2 的幂，那么 1024 的倍数在桶数不超过 1024 时会全部挤进同一个桶。先把键乘上一个大奇数（例如 2654435761）打散再取模，能让分布均匀得多。
扩容时每个键值对要按新的桶数重新计算下标，不能把旧桶原样搬过去。

problem.title: 最小堆

en.title: Min-Heap
en.description:
Implement a binary min-heap `MinHeap` on an array: the parent of index i is `(i - 1) / 2` (rounded down), its children are `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`, and no node is greater than its children. No built-in heap or priority queue may be used (`heapq`, `priority_queue`, `PriorityQueue`, `container/heap`).

The `dump` operation prints the heap's internal array in order, so follow **exactly these steps**:

- `push(x)`: put x at the end of the array, then **sift up**: while it is **strictly less** than its parent, swap them.
- `pop()`: remember the top; move the last element to index 0 and drop the end, then **sift down**: among the existing children pick the smallest (the left one when both are equal); while it is **strictly less** than the current node, swap and continue. Return the remembered top.
- `build(values)`: discard the old contents, place values in the array as given, then sift down every index from the last non-leaf `n / 2 - 1` down to 0 (Floyd's heap construction, O(n)).

Methods to implement: `push(x)`, `pop()`, `top()` (return the minimum), `size()`, `build(values)` and `dump()` (return a copy of the internal array).

The driver calls `pop` and `top` only on a non-empty heap and prints empty itself otherwise.
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

push x / pop / top / size / build k a1 a2 … ak / dump

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, |x|, |ai| ≤ 10^9. The k of all builds sum to at most 2×10^4, and dumps print at most 5×10^4 numbers in total.
en.output: `pop` and `top` print the minimum, or empty for an empty heap; `size` prints the number of elements; `dump` prints every element in array order on one line, separated by spaces, or empty for an empty heap.
en.explanation: Pushing 5 3 8 1: 1 lands at index 3, is less than its parent 5 and swaps up to index 1, then is less than the top 3 and swaps to index 0, giving [1, 3, 8, 5]. pop returns 1 and moves 5 to the top to sift down: of its children 3 and 8, 3 is smaller and less than 5, so they swap, giving [3, 5, 8]. build 5 9 4 7 1 2 places [9, 4, 7, 1, 2] and sifts down from index 1: of 4's children 1 and 2, 1 is the smallest, so they swap, giving [9, 1, 7, 4, 2]. Then index 0: 9 swaps with the smaller child 1 and keeps sinking, swapping with 2, the smaller of its new children 4 and 2, giving [1, 2, 7, 4, 9].
hints: "Left child on ties" and "swap only when strictly less" decide what dump prints; get one wrong and the output differs.
If the heap is empty after a pop, do not sift down index 0.
Why is Floyd's construction O(n)? Most nodes sit near the bottom and sink only a short way.

problem.description:
用数组实现二叉最小堆 `MinHeap`：下标 i 的父节点是 `(i - 1) / 2`（向下取整），孩子是 `2i + 1` 和 `2i + 2`，每个节点都不大于它的孩子。不能用语言自带的堆或优先队列（`heapq`、`priority_queue`、`PriorityQueue`、`container/heap`）。

`dump` 操作会按数组顺序输出堆的内部存储，所以必须**严格按下面的步骤**调整：

- `push(x)`：把 x 放到数组末尾，然后**上浮**：只要它比父节点**严格小**，就和父节点交换。
- `pop()`：记下堆顶；把最后一个元素移到下标 0 并删掉末尾，然后**下沉**：在存在的孩子里选值最小的那个（两个孩子相等时选左孩子），只要它比当前节点**严格小**，就交换并继续。返回记下的堆顶。
- `build(values)`：丢弃原来的内容，把 values 原样放进数组，然后从最后一个非叶子节点 `n / 2 - 1` 到 0 依次对每个下标下沉（Floyd 建堆，O(n)）。

需要实现的方法：`push(x)`、`pop()`、`top()`（返回最小值）、`size()`、`build(values)`、`dump()`（返回内部数组的副本）。

驱动只在堆非空时调用 `pop` 和 `top`，堆为空时直接输出 empty。

push x / pop / top / size / build k a1 a2 … ak / dump

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，|x|、|ai| ≤ 10^9，所有 build 的 k 之和不超过 2×10^4，dump 输出的数字总数不超过 5×10^4。
problem.output: `pop` 和 `top` 输出最小值，堆为空时输出 empty；`size` 输出元素个数；`dump` 在一行内按数组顺序输出所有元素（以空格分隔），堆为空时输出 empty。
problem.explanation: 依次 push 5 3 8 1：1 加入时在下标 3，比父节点 5 小，交换到下标 1，又比堆顶 3 小，交换到下标 0，数组是 [1, 3, 8, 5]。pop 返回 1，把 5 移到堆顶后下沉：孩子 3 和 8 中 3 较小且比 5 小，交换，得到 [3, 5, 8]。build 5 9 4 7 1 2 先放入 [9, 4, 7, 1, 2]，从下标 1 开始下沉：4 的孩子 1 和 2 中 1 最小，交换得 [9, 1, 7, 4, 2]；再处理下标 0：9 与较小的孩子 1 交换后继续下沉，新孩子 4 和 2 中 2 较小，再交换，得到 [1, 2, 7, 4, 9]。
hints: 「相等时选左孩子」「严格小于才交换」这两条规则决定了 dump 的结果，写错一条就会和期望不同。
pop 之后如果堆变空，不要再对下标 0 下沉。
为什么 Floyd 建堆是 O(n)？大多数节点在底部，下沉的距离很短。

problem.title: LRU 缓存

en.title: LRU Cache
en.description:
Implement an LRU (least recently used) cache `LRUCache` holding up to capacity keys. Every `get` hit and every `put` makes its key the most recently used; when a new key does not fit, evict the key unused for the longest time.

Both `get` and `put` must be O(1): a hash map finds a key's node, and a **doubly linked list you write yourself** chains every node by use (most recent at the head, oldest at the tail), so moving or removing a node only relinks pointers. Built-in hash maps are fine (`dict`, `unordered_map`, `HashMap`, Go's `map`); built-in ordered containers are not (`OrderedDict`, `LinkedHashMap`).

Methods to implement:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `get(key)` | Return the value and mark the key most recent; -1 if absent |
| `put(key, value)` | Insert or update and mark the key most recent; if that exceeds the capacity, evict the least recently used key and return it, otherwise return -1 |
| `keys()` | Every key from most to least recent, for the driver to print |
en.input:
The first line holds the capacity and the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

get k / put k v / order

1 ≤ capacity ≤ 10^4, 1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, 0 ≤ k, v ≤ 10^9. The orders print at most 5×10^4 keys in total.
en.output: `get` prints the value or -1; `put` prints the evicted key, or -1 if nothing was evicted; `order` prints every key from most to least recent on one line, separated by spaces, or empty for an empty cache.
en.explanation: The capacity is 2. After put 1 and put 2 the order is 2 1. get 1 hits and makes 1 the most recent: 1 2. put 3 does not fit and evicts the oldest, 2, so get 2 gives -1. put 1 10 only updates key 1 and moves it to the front, evicting nothing. put 4 evicts 3, now the oldest.
hints: With a sentinel node at each end of the list, insertion and removal never check for a missing neighbour.
Updating an existing key leaves the size unchanged and must not evict anything.
An eviction removes the key from both the list and the hash map, so each node stores its key too.

problem.description:
实现容量为 capacity 的 LRU（最近最少使用）缓存 `LRUCache`。每次 `get` 命中或 `put` 一个键，这个键都变成「最近使用」；新键放不下时，淘汰最久没被使用的那个键。

要求 `get` 和 `put` 都是 O(1)：用哈希表从键找到节点，再用一条**自己写的双向链表**按使用时间串起所有节点（表头最近、表尾最久），移动、删除节点都只改指针。可以用语言自带的哈希表（`dict`、`unordered_map`、`HashMap`、Go 的 `map`），但不能用自带顺序的容器（`OrderedDict`、`LinkedHashMap`）。

需要实现的方法：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `get(key)` | 返回值并把键标记为最近使用；键不存在返回 -1 |
| `put(key, value)` | 写入或更新，并标记为最近使用；如果因此超出容量，淘汰最久未使用的键并返回它，否则返回 -1 |
| `keys()` | 从最近到最久列出所有键，供驱动打印 |
problem.input:
第一行是容量 capacity 和操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

get k / put k v / order

1 ≤ capacity ≤ 10^4，1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，0 ≤ k, v ≤ 10^9。order 输出的键总数不超过 5×10^4。
problem.output: `get` 输出值或 -1；`put` 输出被淘汰的键，没有淘汰输出 -1；`order` 在一行内从最近到最久输出所有键（以空格分隔），缓存为空时输出 empty。
problem.explanation: 容量为 2。put 1 和 put 2 之后顺序是 2 1。get 1 命中，1 变成最近，顺序是 1 2。put 3 放不下，淘汰最久的 2。get 2 得到 -1。put 1 10 只是更新 1 的值并把它移到最前，不淘汰。put 4 淘汰此时最久的 3。
hints: 在链表两端各放一个哨兵节点，插入和删除就不用判断「前面或后面是不是空的」。
更新已存在的键不会改变缓存大小，不应该淘汰任何键。
淘汰时要同时从链表和哈希表里删掉这个键，所以节点里也要存键。

problem.title: 二分查找：lower_bound 与 upper_bound

en.title: Binary Search: lower_bound and upper_bound
en.description:
Given a **non-decreasing** integer array a (duplicates allowed), write two binary searches by hand:

- `lower_bound(a, x)`: the first index whose element is **at least** x, or n if every element is less than x.
- `upper_bound(a, x)`: the first index whose element is **strictly greater** than x, or n if no element exceeds x.

Their difference is how many times x occurs. Function names follow each language's conventions (Java `lowerBound`, Go `LowerBound`; in C++ `lower_bound_index`, clear of the standard library's name); the starter code has them. No built-in binary search may be called (`bisect`, `std::lower_bound`, `Arrays.binarySearch`, `sort.Search` and so on).
en.input:
The first line holds n and q. The second line holds n non-decreasing integers. Each of the next q lines holds one query value x.

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4, and every number's absolute value is at most 10^9.
en.output: For each query print one line with two integers: lower_bound and upper_bound (0-based indices).
en.explanation: a = [1, 3, 3, 3, 7, 9]. For 3 the first element ≥ 3 is at index 1 and the first > 3 at index 4, so 3 occurs 4 - 1 = 3 times. 0 is below every element, so both answers are 0; 10 is above every element, so both are 6. 5 is absent, so both answers agree at 4.
hints: Search the half-open range [lo, hi), starting from lo = 0 and hi = n. Loop while lo < hi with mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2.
lower_bound: when a[mid] < x the answer lies to the right, so lo = mid + 1; otherwise hi = mid. upper_bound only changes the test to a[mid] <= x.
When the loop ends lo == hi, and that is the answer. hi starts at n, not n - 1, or the "everything is smaller" case returns the wrong index.

problem.description:
给定一个**非递减**的整数数组 a（可能有重复值），手写两个二分查找函数：

- `lower_bound(a, x)`：第一个**大于等于** x 的下标；所有元素都小于 x 时返回 n。
- `upper_bound(a, x)`：第一个**严格大于** x 的下标；所有元素都不大于 x 时返回 n。

两者之差就是 x 出现的次数。函数名按各语言惯例书写（Java 的 `lowerBound`、Go 的 `LowerBound`；C++ 为避免和标准库重名，叫 `lower_bound_index`），以起始代码为准。不能调用语言自带的二分查找（`bisect`、`std::lower_bound`、`Arrays.binarySearch`、`sort.Search` 等）。
problem.input:
第一行是 n 和 q。第二行是 n 个非递减的整数。接下来 q 行，每行一个查询值 x。

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4，所有数的绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 每个查询输出一行两个整数：lower_bound 和 upper_bound（下标从 0 开始）。
problem.explanation: a = [1, 3, 3, 3, 7, 9]。查询 3：第一个 ≥ 3 的是下标 1，第一个 > 3 的是下标 4，所以 3 出现 4 - 1 = 3 次。查询 0 小于所有元素，两个答案都是 0；查询 10 大于所有元素，两个答案都是 6。查询 5 不在数组里，两个答案相同，都是 4。
hints: 用左闭右开区间 [lo, hi)，初始 lo = 0、hi = n。循环条件 lo < hi，中点 mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2。
lower_bound：a[mid] < x 时答案在右边，lo = mid + 1；否则 hi = mid。upper_bound 只是把条件换成 a[mid] <= x。
循环结束时 lo == hi，就是答案。注意 hi 从 n 开始而不是 n - 1，否则「全部小于 x」的情况会返回错的下标。

problem.title: 快速排序

en.title: Quicksort
en.description:
Implement the two parts of quicksort:

**1. `partition(a, lo, hi)`: Lomuto partition.** With `a[hi]` as the pivot, move every element of `[lo, hi]` smaller than the pivot to the left, then put the pivot in its final place and return that index. Follow **exactly these steps**; the driver checks the partitioned array:

```text
pivot = a[hi]
```

problem.title: Dijkstra 最短路

en.title: Dijkstra's Shortest Paths
en.description:
A graph has n nodes and m **directed edges** with non-negative weights. Implement `dijkstra(n, edges, s)`: return the shortest distance from the source s to every node, with -1 for nodes it cannot reach.

Dijkstra's algorithm: the source starts at distance 0 and every other node at infinity. Repeatedly take the unsettled node with the **smallest distance**; its distance is now final, and its outgoing edges update (relax) its neighbours' distances. Non-negative weights guarantee the current minimum can never improve later.

Keep (distance, node) pairs in a min-heap. When a node's distance drops, push the new pair and leave the old one in the heap; a popped pair whose distance exceeds the recorded one is stale and skipped ("lazy deletion"). The total is O((n + m) log m). A built-in priority queue is fine. Function names follow each language's conventions (Go `Dijkstra`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line holds n, m and s. Each of the next m lines holds three integers u v w: a directed edge from u to v of weight w (parallel edges and self-loops may occur).

1 ≤ n ≤ 10^4, 0 ≤ m ≤ 2×10^4, 1 ≤ s ≤ n, 0 ≤ w ≤ 10^6.
en.output: One line of n integers: the shortest distances from s to nodes 1, 2, …, n, or -1 for unreachable ones.
en.explanation: From 1, the direct edge 1→2 costs 4 but 1→3→2 costs only 1 + 2 = 3. Then 1→3→2→4 costs 3 + 1 = 4, less than 1→3→4 at 1 + 5 = 6. Node 5 has outgoing edges only, so it is unreachable.
hints: Distances can reach 10^6 × 10^4 = 10^10, beyond 32 bits: use 64-bit integers.
Zero-weight edges are fine, but with negative weights Dijkstra is no longer correct; that calls for Bellman-Ford.
Do not settle a node when it is first pushed: its distance is final only when it is popped (and the pair is not stale).

problem.description:
一张 n 个点、m 条**有向边**的图，边权非负。实现 `dijkstra(n, edges, s)`：返回从起点 s 到每个点的最短距离，到不了的点记为 -1。

Dijkstra 算法：起点距离为 0，其余为无穷大。每次从还没确定的点里取出**距离最小**的那个，它的距离就确定了；再用它的出边去更新（松弛）邻居的距离。边权非负保证了「当前最小的不会再被更新得更小」。

problem.title: Bellman-Ford 最短路与负环

en.title: Bellman-Ford and Negative Cycles
en.description:
A graph has n nodes and m **directed edges** whose weights **may be negative**. Implement `bellman_ford(n, edges, s)`:

- If a **negative cycle** (a cycle whose weights sum below 0) is reachable from the source s, shortest paths are meaningless: return "nothing" (Python `None`, an empty vector in C++, Java `null`, Go `nil`);
- Otherwise return the shortest distance from s to every node, with the starter code's constant `INF` for unreachable ones.

Bellman-Ford: the source starts at 0 and every other node at INF. One round relaxes every edge once. A shortest path uses at most n - 1 edges, so after n - 1 rounds every distance is right. Then scan the edges once more: if any edge still shortens a distance, a negative cycle is reachable from s.

Relax only from nodes whose distance is not INF, or "INF plus a negative weight" passes for a reachable distance. Function names follow each language's conventions (Java `bellmanFord`, Go `BellmanFord`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line holds n, m and s. Each of the next m lines holds three integers u v w: a directed edge from u to v of weight w.

1 ≤ n ≤ 500, 0 ≤ m ≤ 2000, 1 ≤ s ≤ n, |w| ≤ 10^4.
en.output: If a negative cycle is reachable from s, print the line NEGATIVE CYCLE. Otherwise print one line of n values: the shortest distances from s to nodes 1, 2, …, n, with INF for unreachable ones.
en.explanation: From 1: 1→2 costs 4, but 1→3→2 costs 5 + (-3) = 2, which is shorter, and 1→3→2→4 costs 2 + 2 = 4. Node 5 is unreachable, so it prints INF.
hints: If a round changes no distance, stop early: nothing will change later either.
Only a negative cycle reachable from s counts. One elsewhere in the graph does not affect the answer, so the final check also looks only at nodes whose distance is not INF.
The cost is O(nm), slower than Dijkstra, in exchange for handling negative weights.

- 否则返回 s 到每个点的最短距离，到不了的点记为起始代码里定义的常量 `INF`。

Bellman-Ford 算法：起点距离为 0，其余为 INF。把所有边松弛一遍算一轮，最短路最多经过 n - 1 条边，所以 n - 1 轮之后距离一定都正确了。之后再扫一遍所有边，如果还有边能让距离变小，说明有从 s 能到达的负环。

A weighted graph has n nodes and m **undirected edges**, numbered 1 to m in input order. Implement `kruskal(n, edges)`: find a minimum spanning tree with Kruskal's algorithm and return the chosen edges' indices (0-based) **in the order they were chosen**.

The driver totals the weights of the returned edges; fewer than n - 1 chosen edges means the graph is disconnected and it prints -1. A built-in sort is fine. Function names follow each language's conventions (Go `Kruskal`); the starter code has them.

problem.title: Prim 最小生成树（稠密图）

en.title: Prim's Minimum Spanning Tree (Dense Graphs)
en.description:
An undirected weighted graph on n nodes comes as an **adjacency matrix**: `w[i][j]` is the weight of the edge between i and j, -1 means no edge, and the diagonal is 0. Implement `prim(n, w)`: find a minimum spanning tree with the O(n²) version of Prim's algorithm and return the **order in which the nodes join the tree**. Inside the function nodes are numbered from 0 (`w` is a 0-based n × n array too); the driver adds 1 when printing.

Prim's algorithm starts from node 1 (node 0 inside the function) and keeps, for every node outside the tree, a `key`: the weight of the lightest edge between it and the tree (infinity if none). Each step adds the outside node with the smallest key (**the smaller number on ties**), then uses its edges to update the remaining keys. If every remaining key is infinite, the graph is disconnected; stop there.

A dense graph needs no heap: each step scans every node for the smallest key, n steps in all, exactly O(n²), on par with reading the matrix. The driver totals the weights from the returned order and prints -1 when fewer than n nodes come back. Function names follow each language's conventions (Go `Prim`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line is n. Each of the next n lines holds n integers; the j-th on line i is w[i][j]. The matrix is symmetric with w[i][i] = 0, and every other entry is -1 or a weight from 1 to 1000.

1 ≤ n ≤ 200.

en.explanation: From 1, the keys are 2 for node 2, 6 for node 3 and 5 for node 4. Node 2 joins and lowers node 3's key to 3. Node 3 joins (key 3) and lowers node 4's key to 1. Node 4 joins last. The total is 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 and the order 1 2 3 4.
hints: Mark tree membership in a boolean array; keys start at infinity, with key[1] = 0.
"The smaller number on ties" means the scan replaces its minimum only on a strictly smaller key.
On sparse graphs a heap with adjacency lists gives O(m log n); on dense ones m is near n², and the O(n²) version wins.

problem.title: 并查集（路径压缩 + 按秩合并）

en.title: Union-Find (Path Compression + Union by Rank)
en.description:
Implement a union-find `UnionFind(n)` over n nodes numbered 1 to n, each starting in its own set:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `find(x)` | Return the representative (root) of x's set |
| `union(a, b)` | Merge the sets of a and b; return true if they were apart, false otherwise |
| `same(a, b)` | Whether a and b share a set |
| `size(x)` | Number of elements in x's set |
| `count()` | Current number of sets |

Each set is a tree in which `parent[x]` points to x's parent and a root points to itself. Two optimizations bring each operation's amortized cost close to constant (inverse Ackermann):

- **Path compression**: during `find`, hang the nodes passed on the way straight under the root (or every other one under its grandparent);
- **Union by rank**: when merging, hang the shorter (lower rank) or smaller tree under the other.

Method names follow each language's conventions (Go `Union`; `union` is a C++ keyword, so C++ calls it `unite`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line holds n and q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

union a b / same a b / size x / count

1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, 1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4, 1 ≤ a, b, x ≤ n.
en.output: `union` prints 1 if it merged two sets and 0 if they were already one; `same` prints 1 for the same set and 0 otherwise; `size` prints the set's size; `count` prints the number of sets.
en.explanation: The 5 nodes start as 5 sets. union 1 2 and union 3 4 leave 3 sets; union 2 1 finds 1 and 2 already together and prints 0. union 1 3 merges {1, 2} and {3, 4} into a set of size 4, same 2 4 is 1, and 2 sets remain.
hints: Path compression without union by rank is O(log n) amortized in the worst case; only both together get near constant.
With union by size, keep each root's set size as you merge, and size becomes O(α(n)).
A recursive find can overflow the stack on a deep tree; a loop with "path halving" (parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]) is safer.

| `union(a, b)` | 合并 a、b 所在的集合；原来不在同一集合返回真，否则返回假 |

problem.title: 字典树（Trie）

en.title: Trie
en.description:
Implement a trie `Trie` of lowercase words, where the same word may be inserted several times (counted each time):

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `insert(word)` | Insert word once |
| `erase(word)` | If word is present at least once, remove one copy and return true; otherwise return false |
| `search(word)` | Whether word is present at least once |
| `count_prefix(p)` | How many words start with p (counting copies; p itself starts with p) |

Each node has 26 children (an array or a map) and two counters: `pass`, the number of words through the node, and `end`, the number ending exactly there. Insertion and removal adjust pass along the path and end at the last node; `count_prefix` walks to p's last node and reads its pass. Every operation is O(word length).

No hash map or set may store whole words. Method names follow each language's conventions (Java `countPrefix`, Go `CountPrefix`); the starter code has them.
en.input:
The first line is the number of operations q. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

insert w / erase w / search w / prefix p

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4; words and prefixes are lowercase letters, 1 to 20 long.
en.output: `erase` prints 1 if it removed a copy and 0 otherwise; `search` prints 1 if the word is present and 0 otherwise; `prefix` prints how many words start with p.
en.explanation: After inserting apple, app and apple, 3 words start with app (apple twice and app once) and 2 with apple. search ap is 0: ap is only a prefix and was never inserted as a word. erase apple removes one copy, one apple remains, so search apple is still 1; of the next two erases, the second fails.
hints: Before erasing, make sure the word exists, or decrementing pass along the way drives counts negative.
Erased nodes need not be freed: a node whose pass is 0 is as good as absent.
Nodes can be objects with pointers or one big array: next[node][c] holds a child's number, 0 meaning none.

problem.description:
实现一棵存小写单词的字典树 `Trie`，同一个单词可以插入多次（按次数计）：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `insert(word)` | 插入 word 一次 |
| `erase(word)` | 如果 word 至少还有一次，删除一次并返回真；否则返回假 |
| `search(word)` | word 是否至少还有一次 |
| `count_prefix(p)` | 以 p 为前缀的单词有多少个（按次数计，p 本身也算以 p 为前缀） |

每个节点有 26 个孩子（数组或映射都可以），并记两个计数：`pass` 是经过这个节点的单词数，`end` 是恰好在这里结束的单词数。插入和删除沿路径修改 pass，在终点修改 end；`count_prefix` 走到 p 的末尾节点读它的 pass。每个操作都是 O(单词长度)。

不能用哈希表或集合直接存整个单词。方法名按各语言惯例书写（Java 的 `countPrefix`、Go 的 `CountPrefix`），以起始代码为准。
problem.input:
第一行是操作数 q。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

insert w / erase w / search w / prefix p

1 ≤ q ≤ 2×10^4，单词和前缀只含小写字母，长度在 1 到 20 之间。
problem.output: `erase` 删除成功输出 1，否则输出 0；`search` 存在输出 1，否则输出 0；`prefix` 输出以 p 为前缀的单词个数。
problem.explanation: 插入 apple、app、apple 之后，以 app 为前缀的有 3 个（apple 两次加 app 一次），以 apple 为前缀的有 2 个。search ap 为 0：ap 只是前缀，没有作为单词插入过。erase apple 删掉一次，apple 还剩一次，所以 search apple 仍为 1；再删两次，第二次失败。
hints: erase 之前先确认单词存在，否则沿路减 pass 会把计数减成负数。
删除后不必真的回收节点，pass 为 0 的节点就相当于不存在。
节点可以用对象加指针，也可以用一个大数组：next[node][c] 存孩子的编号，0 表示没有。

problem.title: 线段树：区间和与单点修改

en.title: Segment Tree: Range Sums and Point Updates
en.description:
Given an integer array of length n, implement a segment tree `SegmentTree(values)` supporting:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `update(i, x)` | Set element i to x |
| `query(l, r)` | Return the sum of elements l through r (inclusive) |

Indices in the methods are 0-based; the input's are 1-based, and the driver converts them. Both operations must run in O(log n).

Each node of a segment tree holds the sum of a range: the root covers the whole array, each child covers half of its parent, and the leaves are single elements. An update walks from a leaf up to the root; a query splits [l, r] into O(log n) whole nodes and adds them.

Either array layout works: the recursive one uses an array of size `4n` where node k's children are 2k and 2k + 1; the iterative one uses size `2n`, with the leaves at `n .. 2n - 1` and node k's parent at k / 2.
en.input:
The first line holds n and q, the second the n integers. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

set i x / sum l r

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4, 1 ≤ i ≤ n, 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n, and every number's absolute value is at most 10^9.
en.output: For each sum, one line with the range sum.
en.explanation: The array is [5, -2, 7, 1, 3]. sum 1 3 = 5 - 2 + 7 = 10. After set 2 4 the array is [5, 4, 7, 1, 3], so sum 1 3 = 16, sum 2 5 = 15 and sum 4 4 = 1.
hints: Sums can reach 2×10^4 × 10^9 = 2×10^13, beyond 32 bits: use 64-bit integers.
The iterative query: l += n and r += n + 1; then while l < r, if l is a right child take tree[l] and l++, if r is a right child r-- and take tree[r], and halve both.
If the array never changed, prefix sums would do; a segment tree earns its keep by making both updates and queries O(log n).

problem.description:
给一个长度为 n 的整数数组，实现线段树 `SegmentTree(values)`，支持：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `update(i, x)` | 把第 i 个元素改成 x |
| `query(l, r)` | 返回第 l 到第 r 个元素（含两端）的和 |

方法里的下标从 0 开始；输入中的下标从 1 开始，由驱动换算。两个操作都要做到 O(log n)。

线段树的每个节点保存一段区间的和：根是整个数组，左右孩子各管一半，叶子是单个元素。修改时从叶子一路更新到根；查询时把 [l, r] 拆成 O(log n) 个完整节点的区间相加。

数组写法有两种，都可以：递归版用 `4n` 大小的数组，节点 k 的孩子是 2k 和 2k + 1；迭代版用 `2n` 大小，叶子放在 `n .. 2n - 1`，节点 k 的父亲是 k / 2。
problem.input:
第一行是 n 和 q，第二行是 n 个整数。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

set i x / sum l r

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4，1 ≤ i ≤ n，1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n，所有数的绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 每个 sum 输出一行区间和。
hints: 迭代版查询：l += n、r += n + 1，然后在 l < r 时，l 是右孩子就取 tree[l] 并 l++，r 是右孩子就 r-- 并取 tree[r]，再同时除以 2。
如果数组从不修改，前缀和就够了；线段树的价值在于修改和查询都是 O(log n)。

problem.title: 树状数组（Fenwick Tree）

en.title: Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree)
en.description:
Given an array of n **non-negative** integers (indices 1 to n), implement a Fenwick tree `FenwickTree(values)` supporting:

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `add(i, x)` | Add x to element i |
| `prefix(i)` | The sum of the first i elements (`prefix(0)` is 0) |
| `kth(k)` | The smallest index j whose first j elements sum to at least k, or -1 if the total is below k |

In a Fenwick tree, `tree[i]` holds the sum of the range `(i - lowbit(i), i]`, where `lowbit(i) = i & -i` is i's lowest set bit. `add` climbs with `i += lowbit(i)` and `prefix` descends with `i -= lowbit(i)`, both O(log n).

Do not answer `kth` with a binary search over prefix (that is O(log² n)); use **binary lifting** instead: try steps from the highest power of two down, and whenever `pos + step` is in range and `tree[pos + step] < k`, advance pos by step and subtract `tree[pos]` from k. The answer is pos + 1. This relies on every element being non-negative, so prefix sums never decrease.
en.input:
The first line holds n and q, the second the n non-negative integers. Each of the next q lines is one operation:

add i x / prefix i / kth k

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4, initial values are at most 10^4, |x| ≤ 10^4 and no element ever goes negative, 0 ≤ i ≤ n (i ≥ 1 for add), 1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9.
en.output: Each prefix prints the prefix sum and each kth prints the index or -1.
en.explanation: The array is [3, 0, 2, 5]. prefix 3 = 5. For kth 4, the first 3 elements sum to 5 ≥ 4 while the first 2 sum to 3 < 4, so the answer is 3. After add 2 1 the array is [3, 1, 2, 5] and kth 4 becomes 2. kth 11 = 4, kth 12 exceeds the total of 11 and prints -1, and kth 1 = 1.
hints: Fenwick indices start at 1: lowbit(0) = 0, and starting from 0 loops forever.
Building can call add once per element, O(n log n), or take O(n): put the values into tree, then let each i add tree[i] into tree[i + lowbit(i)].
kth only makes sense for non-negative elements; with negatives, prefix sums are not monotonic and another structure is needed.

problem.description:
给一个长度为 n 的**非负**整数数组（下标 1 到 n），实现树状数组 `FenwickTree(values)`，支持：

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `add(i, x)` | 第 i 个元素加上 x |
| `prefix(i)` | 前 i 个元素的和（`prefix(0)` 为 0） |
| `kth(k)` | 最小的下标 j，使得前 j 个元素的和不小于 k；总和小于 k 时返回 -1 |

树状数组里 `tree[i]` 保存区间 `(i - lowbit(i), i]` 的和，`lowbit(i) = i & -i` 是 i 最低的那个二进制 1。`add` 沿 `i += lowbit(i)` 向上更新，`prefix` 沿 `i -= lowbit(i)` 向下累加，都是 O(log n)。

`kth` 不要二分套 prefix（那是 O(log² n)），而是**倍增**：从最高的 2 的幂开始往下试，`pos + step` 不越界且 `tree[pos + step] < k` 时，就把 pos 前进 step，并从 k 里减去 `tree[pos]`。最后答案是 pos + 1。这依赖于所有元素非负，前缀和单调不减。
problem.input:
第一行是 n 和 q，第二行是 n 个非负整数。接下来 q 行，每行一个操作：

add i x / prefix i / kth k

1 ≤ n, q ≤ 2×10^4，初始值不超过 10^4，|x| ≤ 10^4 且任何时刻每个元素都不为负，0 ≤ i ≤ n（add 时 i ≥ 1），1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9。
problem.output: 每个 prefix 输出前缀和，每个 kth 输出下标或 -1。
problem.explanation: 数组是 [3, 0, 2, 5]。prefix 3 = 5。kth 4：前 3 个的和是 5 ≥ 4，前 2 个的和是 3 < 4，所以答案是 3。add 2 1 后数组变成 [3, 1, 2, 5]，kth 4 变成 2。kth 11 = 4，kth 12 超过总和 11，输出 -1。kth 1 = 1。
hints: 树状数组的下标从 1 开始：lowbit(0) = 0，从 0 开始会死循环。
建树可以对每个元素调用一次 add，O(n log n)；也可以 O(n)：先把值放进 tree，再让每个 i 把 tree[i] 加到 tree[i + lowbit(i)] 上。
元素值非负时 kth 才有意义；如果有负数，前缀和不单调，就只能用别的结构了。

problem.title: 按序执行

en.title: Run in Order
en.description:
Three threads share one `InOrder` object: one calls `first(job)`, one calls `second(job)` and one calls `third(job)`, each exactly once. Which thread starts first, and which reaches its method first, is entirely up to chance.

Make the three `job`s run strictly in the order first, second, third, each exactly once. Wait with blocking primitives (locks, condition variables, semaphores, events, CountDownLatch, channels), not with a hopeful `sleep` or a loop that keeps polling a flag.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `first(job)` | Run job |
| `second(job)` | Run job once first's job has finished |
| `third(job)` | Run job once second's job has finished |

The driver runs many rounds. Each round makes a new `InOrder`, starts the three threads in a random order, and randomly yields or sleeps briefly around each `job` so that unsynchronized code fails early. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines holds three words: the words that round's first, second and third jobs record.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, 0 ≤ seed < 2^31, and each word is 1 to 8 lowercase letters.
en.output: One line per round: the words that round's jobs actually recorded, in the order they ran, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: The first round's words are wake, wash and work. Whichever thread starts first, second must wait until first's job has recorded wake before running its own job, and third must wait for wash, so the line is always wake wash work. A line comes out different if the jobs run out of order or a method never calls its job.
hints: Two "finished" signals are enough: second waits for first's, third waits for second's.
Python has threading.Event, Java has CountDownLatch, Go can close a channel to broadcast, and C++ can use a mutex with a condition_variable.
With a condition variable, check the condition in a while loop before each wait: being woken up does not mean it holds.

problem.description:
三个线程共用一个 `InOrder` 对象：一个线程调用 `first(job)`，一个调用 `second(job)`，一个调用 `third(job)`，每个方法恰好被调用一次。三个线程谁先启动、谁先跑到方法里，完全随机。

请让三个 `job` 严格按 first、second、third 的顺序执行，每个执行一次。等待要用阻塞原语（锁、条件变量、信号量、Event、CountDownLatch、channel 等），不要靠 `sleep` 碰运气，也不要空转循环反复检查标志。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `first(job)` | 运行 job |
| `second(job)` | 等 first 的 job 结束后，再运行 job |
| `third(job)` | 等 second 的 job 结束后，再运行 job |

驱动会测很多轮：每轮新建一个 `InOrder`，随机打乱三个线程的启动顺序，还会在 `job` 前后随机让出 CPU 或短暂休眠，让没做同步的写法尽早暴露。判题只比较输出，所以绕开线程直接拼出答案也能通过，但那样就没有练到并发。
problem.input:
第一行是随机种子 seed 和轮数 R。接下来 R 行，每行三个单词，依次是这一轮 first、second、third 的 job 要记录的单词。

1 ≤ R ≤ 100，0 ≤ seed < 2^31，单词由 1 到 8 个小写字母组成。
problem.output: 每轮输出一行：这一轮三个 job 实际记录下的单词，按执行的先后顺序，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 第一轮的三个单词是 wake、wash、work。不管哪个线程先启动，second 都要等 first 的 job 记下 wake 之后才运行自己的 job，third 要等 wash 记下之后才运行，所以这一行一定是 wake wash work。如果 job 不按顺序执行，或者有方法没有调用 job，这一行就会不同。
hints: 只需要两个“已完成”的信号：second 等 first 的信号，third 等 second 的信号。
Python 可以用 threading.Event，Java 可以用 CountDownLatch，Go 可以关闭一个 channel 来广播，C++ 可以用 mutex 加 condition_variable。
用条件变量时，要在 while 循环里检查条件再 wait，被唤醒后条件不一定成立。

problem.title: 交替输出

en.title: Take Turns
en.description:
Two threads share one `FooBar` object: one calls `foo(emit)` and the other calls `bar(emit)`. Each method must call `emit` n times, and the calls must strictly alternate: foo, then bar, then foo, then bar, 2n calls in all.

Which thread starts first is random. Do not `sleep` to wait for the other side or loop over a flag; hand the turn back and forth with blocking primitives such as semaphores, condition variables or channels.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `FooBar(n)` | How many times each side calls emit |
| `foo(emit)` | Call emit n times, each time waiting for foo's turn |
| `bar(emit)` | Call emit n times, each time waiting for bar's turn |

The driver runs many rounds. Each round makes a new `FooBar`, picks at random which thread starts first, and randomly yields or sleeps briefly around each `emit`. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines holds n and two words: foo's emit records the first word and bar's emit records the second.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, 1 ≤ n ≤ 40, 0 ≤ seed < 2^31, and each word is 1 to 6 lowercase letters.
en.output: One line per round: the words recorded by that round's emit calls, in the order they were called, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: In the first round n = 3, foo records tick and bar records tock. The correct alternation is tick tock tick tock tick tock: even when bar's thread starts first, it has to wait for foo's first emit.
hints: Two semaphores can say whose turn it is: foo's starts at 1, bar's at 0, and each emit hands the turn to the other side.
In Go, two channels of capacity 1 can pass a single token back and forth.
One condition variable and a foo_turn flag also work: wait for your turn, emit, flip foo_turn and wake the other side.

problem.description:
两个线程共用一个 `FooBar` 对象：一个线程调用 `foo(emit)`，另一个调用 `bar(emit)`。两个方法里各自要调用 n 次 `emit`，并且所有调用必须严格交替：foo 先，然后 bar，再 foo，再 bar……一共 2n 次。

两个线程的启动先后是随机的。不要用 `sleep` 去等对方，也不要空转循环检查标志，用信号量、条件变量、channel 这类阻塞原语轮流交出执行权。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `FooBar(n)` | 每一方要调用 emit 的次数 |
| `foo(emit)` | 调用 n 次 emit，每次都等轮到 foo |
| `bar(emit)` | 调用 n 次 emit，每次都等轮到 bar |

驱动会测很多轮，每轮新建一个 `FooBar`，随机决定哪个线程先启动，并在 `emit` 前后随机让出 CPU 或短暂休眠。判题只比较输出，所以绕开线程直接拼出答案也能通过，但那样就没有练到并发。
problem.input:
第一行是随机种子 seed 和轮数 R。接下来 R 行，每行是 n 和两个单词：foo 一方的 emit 记录第一个单词，bar 一方的 emit 记录第二个单词。

1 ≤ R ≤ 100，1 ≤ n ≤ 40，0 ≤ seed < 2^31，单词由 1 到 6 个小写字母组成。
problem.output: 每轮输出一行：这一轮所有 emit 按调用先后记录下的单词，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 第一轮 n = 3，foo 一方记 tick，bar 一方记 tock。正确的交替是 tick tock tick tock tick tock。即使 bar 的线程先启动，它也要等 foo 先 emit 一次。
hints: 两个信号量就能表示“轮到谁”：foo 的初值为 1，bar 的初值为 0；每次 emit 之后把执行权交给对方。
Go 可以用两个容量为 1 的 channel 传递一个“令牌”。
用一个条件变量和一个 foo_turn 布尔值也可以：等到轮到自己，emit，翻转 foo_turn，再唤醒对方。

import threading


class FooBar:
    """交替输出 / Take turns: foo and bar each call emit n times, foo first, strictly alternating."""

    def __init__(self, n: int):
        self.n = n
        # TODO: 需要的同步工具 / the synchronization you need

    def foo(self, emit):
        pass  # TODO: 调用 n 次 emit()，每次都轮到 foo 时才调用 / call emit() n times, each on foo's turn

    def bar(self, emit):
        pass  # TODO: 调用 n 次 emit()，每次都轮到 bar 时才调用 / call emit() n times, each on bar's turn


# —— 以下驱动代码请勿修改 / Driver code below: do not modify ——
import random
import sys
import threading
import time


def pause(rng):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.4:
        time.sleep(0)
    elif r < 0.45:
        time.sleep(0.00005)


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    rng = random.Random(int(data[0]))
    sys.setswitchinterval(1e-5)
    out = []
    for r in range(int(data[1])):
        n, words = int(data[2 + 3 * r]), data[3 + 3 * r : 5 + 3 * r]
        pair, log = FooBar(n), []

        def worker(side, own):
            def emit():
                pause(own)
                log.append(words[side])
                pause(own)

            pause(own)
            (pair.foo, pair.bar)[side](emit)

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(k, random.Random(rng.random()))) for k in range(2)]
        rng.shuffle(threads)
        for t in threads:
            t.start()
        for t in threads:
            t.join()
        out.append(" ".join(log))
    print("\n".join(out))


main()

problem.title: 零、偶、奇

en.title: Zero, Even, Odd
en.description:
Three threads share one `ZeroEvenOdd` object and call `zero(emit)`, `even(emit)` and `odd(emit)`, one each. Between them, the three methods must hand `emit` these 2n numbers in this order:

0 1 0 2 0 3 … 0 n

so every positive integer comes right after a 0. `zero` emits all the zeros, `odd` emits the odd numbers 1, 3, 5, … and `even` the even numbers 2, 4, 6, …. A method may call `emit` only when it is its turn.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `ZeroEvenOdd(n)` | The largest positive integer to emit |
| `zero(emit)` | Call emit(0) n times, once before each positive integer |
| `even(emit)` | Emit every even number up to n, in order |
| `odd(emit)` | Emit every odd number up to n, in order |

The driver runs many rounds. Each round makes a new object, starts the three threads in a random order, and randomly yields or sleeps briefly around each `emit`. Do not wait with `sleep` or a polling loop. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines holds one n.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, 1 ≤ n ≤ 50, 0 ≤ seed < 2^31.
en.output: One line per round: the numbers emit received in that round, in the order of the calls, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: In the first round n = 2, and the right order is 0 1 0 2. In the third round n = 1: even has nothing to emit and should just return, so the line is 0 1.
hints: Three semaphores can say whose turn it is: zero's starts at 1 and the other two at 0. After each 0, zero wakes odd or even depending on the next number, and they hand the turn back to zero.
Each method knows in advance how many times it loops, so no separate "done" signal is needed.
One condition variable works too: share a "what comes next" value and let each thread wait until it equals the value it is about to emit.

problem.description:
三个线程共用一个 `ZeroEvenOdd` 对象，分别调用 `zero(emit)`、`even(emit)` 和 `odd(emit)`。三个方法合起来，要让 `emit` 按这个顺序收到 2n 个数：

0 1 0 2 0 3 … 0 n

也就是每个正整数前面都先输出一个 0。`zero` 负责所有的 0，`odd` 负责奇数 1, 3, 5, …，`even` 负责偶数 2, 4, 6, …。每个方法只能在轮到自己时调用 `emit`。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ZeroEvenOdd(n)` | 要输出的最大正整数 |
| `zero(emit)` | 调用 n 次 emit(0)，每个正整数之前一次 |
| `even(emit)` | 按顺序 emit 不超过 n 的每个偶数 |
| `odd(emit)` | 按顺序 emit 不超过 n 的每个奇数 |

驱动会测很多轮，每轮新建对象，随机打乱三个线程的启动顺序，并在 `emit` 前后随机让出 CPU 或短暂休眠。不要用 `sleep` 或空转循环等待。判题只比较输出，所以绕开线程直接拼出答案也能通过，但那样就没有练到并发。
problem.input:
第一行是随机种子 seed 和轮数 R。接下来 R 行，每行一个 n。

1 ≤ R ≤ 100，1 ≤ n ≤ 50，0 ≤ seed < 2^31。
problem.output: 每轮输出一行：这一轮 emit 按调用先后收到的数，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: 第一轮 n = 2，正确的顺序是 0 1 0 2。第三轮 n = 1，even 没有要输出的数，应该直接返回；这一行是 0 1。
hints: 用三个信号量表示“轮到谁”：zero 的初值为 1，另外两个为 0。zero 每输出一个 0，就根据下一个数的奇偶唤醒 odd 或 even；它们输出后再把执行权还给 zero。
每个方法事先就知道自己要循环几次，不需要额外的“结束”信号。
用一个条件变量也行：共享一个“下一个该输出什么”的变量，每个线程等到它等于自己要输出的值。

problem.title: 造水分子

en.title: Building Water
en.description:
Every atom is a thread: a hydrogen calls `hydrogen(bond)` and an oxygen calls `oxygen(bond)`, once each. Atoms arrive in random order. Implement `H2O` so the atoms form water molecules:

- Every atom calls `bond()` once, joining a molecule.
- Taken in the order they happen, every three `bond()` calls form one molecule, which must be exactly two hydrogens and one oxygen.
- No atom of the next molecule may start `bond()` until all three `bond()` calls of the current molecule have finished.
- An atom waits until a whole molecule can form: if three hydrogens have arrived and no oxygen yet, the third hydrogen has to wait for the next molecule.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `hydrogen(bond)` | A hydrogen: wait for its molecule's turn, then call bond once |
| `oxygen(bond)` | An oxygen: wait for its molecule's turn, then call bond once |

The driver runs many rounds. Each round makes a new `H2O`, starts the atom threads in the order given, and randomly yields or sleeps briefly around each `bond`. It records every `bond` itself and reports a wrongly built molecule the moment it happens. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines is a string of H and O: the order in which that round's atom threads start. Every string has exactly twice as many H as O.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, each string holds 1 to 6 O, and 0 ≤ seed < 2^31.
en.output:
For a round in which every atom bonds correctly, one line: the number of molecules formed.

As soon as the driver finds a problem, it prints one more line after those already printed, round k: followed by what went wrong, and stops. The problems are molecule m got a third hydrogen, molecule m got a second oxygen, and a of b atoms bonded (only a atoms of the round called bond).
en.explanation: In the second round the atoms start in the order OOHHHH. When the second oxygen arrives, the first molecule still lacks its hydrogens, so the second oxygen has to wait until all three bonds of the first molecule have finished before it joins the second. The round forms 2 molecules.
hints: The classic approach: a hydrogen semaphore starting at 2 and an oxygen semaphore starting at 1 count the free seats in the current molecule; atoms with a seat meet at a three-party barrier, call bond, then give the seat back.
Give the seat back only after bond, so the next molecule cannot fill up until all three bonds of this one have finished.
One condition variable also works: count the hydrogens and oxygens let into the current molecule and how many have bonded; once all three have, reset the counts and wake the waiting atoms.

problem.description:
每个原子都是一个线程：氢原子调用 `hydrogen(bond)`，氧原子调用 `oxygen(bond)`，每个原子只调用一次。原子到达的先后是随机的。请实现 `H2O`，让原子凑成一个个水分子：

- 每个原子都要调用一次 `bond()`，表示它进入了分子。
- 所有 `bond()` 调用按发生的先后，每 3 个算一个分子，每个分子必须恰好是 2 个氢和 1 个氧。
- 一个分子的 3 次 `bond()` 全部结束之前，下一个分子的原子不能开始 `bond()`。
- 原子要等到能凑成完整分子时才能 `bond()`：比如已经来了 3 个氢但还没有氧，第三个氢就得等下一个分子。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `hydrogen(bond)` | 氢原子：等轮到自己所在的分子，调用一次 bond |
| `oxygen(bond)` | 氧原子：等轮到自己所在的分子，调用一次 bond |

problem.title: 哲学家就餐

en.title: Dining Philosophers
en.description:
n philosophers, numbered 0 to n - 1, sit around a round table. One fork lies between each pair of neighbours, n forks in all: fork p sits between philosopher p and philosopher (p + 1) % n. So philosopher p may only use forks p and (p + 1) % n, and needs both in hand to eat.

Each philosopher is a thread that calls `dine(p, pick, eat, drop)` several times. In each call, pick up your two forks with `pick(f)`, call `eat()` once, then put both forks down with `drop(f)`. Make sure that:

- A fork is in at most one philosopher's hands at a time: no `pick` while someone else holds it.
- During `eat()` the philosopher holds both of their forks, and `dine` puts both down before returning.
- Nothing deadlocks: every philosopher gets all of their meals. If everyone picks up their left fork first, for example, each can end up holding one fork and waiting forever for the other.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `DiningTable(n)` | The number of philosophers and forks |
| `dine(p, pick, eat, drop)` | Philosopher p eats once: pick both forks, eat once, drop both forks |

`pick`, `eat` and `drop` are the driver's bookkeeping and never block, so mutual exclusion is up to your own locks: typically take fork f's lock, then call `pick(f)`, and release it only after `drop(f)`. The driver starts the threads in a random order and randomly yields or sleeps briefly around these calls. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines holds n, then n numbers: how many times philosophers 0 to n - 1 each call dine in that round.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, 2 ≤ n ≤ 7, 0 to 8 calls each, and 0 ≤ seed < 2^31.
en.output:
For a round in which every philosopher finishes, one line: how many times each philosopher ate, separated by spaces.

As soon as the driver finds a problem, it prints one more line after those already printed, round k: followed by what went wrong, and stops. For example philosopher 2 picked up fork 3 while philosopher 3 held it, philosopher 1 ate without holding forks 1 and 2, philosopher 0 left the table holding a fork, or philosopher 4 ate 0 times in one dine call (a dine call must eat exactly once).
en.explanation: In the first round five philosophers eat once each, so the line is 1 1 1 1 1. In the third round philosopher 0 never calls dine, while philosophers 1 and 2 share fork 2 and cannot eat at the same time; the line is 0 2 1.
hints: Give each fork a lock. The simplest way to break circular waiting is a fixed order: everyone picks up their lower-numbered fork first.
Another way is a semaphore starting at n - 1: with at most n - 1 philosophers reaching for forks at once, someone always gets both.
A single global lock is also correct, but then only one philosopher eats at a time.

problem.description:
n 位哲学家围坐在圆桌旁，编号 0 到 n - 1。每两位相邻的哲学家之间放着一把叉子，共 n 把：叉子 p 在哲学家 p 和哲学家 (p + 1) % n 之间。所以哲学家 p 只能用叉子 p 和叉子 (p + 1) % n，吃饭时两把都要拿在手里。

每位哲学家是一个线程，会多次调用 `dine(p, pick, eat, drop)`。每次调用里你要：用 `pick(f)` 拿起自己的两把叉子，调用一次 `eat()`，再用 `drop(f)` 放下这两把叉子。请保证：

- 同一把叉子同一时刻只在一位哲学家手里：别人拿着时不能 `pick`。
- `eat()` 时手里要有自己的两把叉子；`dine` 返回前两把叉子都要放下。
- 不能死锁：所有哲学家都要吃完自己的份。比如每人都先拿左手边的叉子，就可能人人拿着一把、等着另一把。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `DiningTable(n)` | 哲学家和叉子的数量 |
| `dine(p, pick, eat, drop)` | 哲学家 p 吃一次：pick 两把叉子，eat 一次，drop 两把叉子 |

`pick`、`eat`、`drop` 是驱动的记录函数，本身不会阻塞，互斥要靠你自己的锁来保证：通常是先拿到叉子 f 对应的锁，再调用 `pick(f)`，`drop(f)` 之后再释放这把锁。驱动会随机打乱线程启动顺序，并在这些调用前后随机让出 CPU 或短暂休眠。判题只比较输出，所以绕开线程直接拼出答案也能通过，但那样就没有练到并发。

第一行是随机种子 seed 和轮数 R。接下来 R 行，每行先是 n，再是 n 个数：哲学家 0 到 n - 1 这一轮各要调用几次 dine。

1 ≤ R ≤ 100，2 ≤ n ≤ 7，每人 0 到 8 次，0 ≤ seed < 2^31。
problem.output:
每轮全部哲学家吃完时，输出一行：每位哲学家实际吃的次数，以空格分隔。

驱动一旦发现问题，就在已经输出的行后面再输出一行 round k: 加上问题描述，然后立即结束。比如 philosopher 2 picked up fork 3 while philosopher 3 held it（拿了别人手里的叉子）、philosopher 1 ate without holding forks 1 and 2（没拿齐叉子就吃）、philosopher 0 left the table holding a fork（dine 返回时还拿着叉子）、philosopher 4 ate 0 times in one dine call（一次 dine 没有恰好吃一次）。
problem.explanation: 第一轮 5 位哲学家各吃一次，输出 1 1 1 1 1。第三轮哲学家 0 一次也不调用 dine；哲学家 1 和 2 共用叉子 2，不能同时吃，输出 0 2 1。
hints: 给每把叉子一把锁。打破“循环等待”最简单的办法是规定顺序：每个人都先拿编号小的那把叉子。
另一种办法是用一个初值为 n - 1 的信号量，最多允许 n - 1 个人同时去拿叉子，这样总有人能拿齐。
一把全局锁也能保证正确，但同一时刻只有一个人在吃。

import os
import random
import sys
import threading
import time


def pause(rng):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.4:
        time.sleep(0)
    elif r < 0.45:
        time.sleep(0.00005)


def main():
    it = iter(sys.stdin.read().split())
    rng = random.Random(int(next(it)))
    sys.setswitchinterval(1e-5)
    out = []
    for r in range(int(next(it))):
        n = int(next(it))
        wanted = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
        table, guard = DiningTable(n), threading.Lock()
        holder, meals = [-1] * n, [0] * n

        def fail(message):
            sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out + [f"round {r + 1}: {message}"]) + "\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
            os._exit(0)

        def philosopher(p, own):
            forks = (p, (p + 1) % n)

            def pick(f):
                pause(own)
                with guard:
                    if f not in forks:
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} picked up fork {f}, which is not next to them")
                    if holder[f] != -1:
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} picked up fork {f} while philosopher {holder[f]} held it")
                    holder[f] = p
                pause(own)

            def eat():
                with guard:
                    if holder[forks[0]] != p or holder[forks[1]] != p:
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} ate without holding forks {forks[0]} and {forks[1]}")
                    meals[p] += 1
                pause(own)

            def drop(f):
                pause(own)
                with guard:
                    if holder[f] != p:
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} put down fork {f} without holding it")
                    holder[f] = -1

            for _ in range(wanted[p]):
                pause(own)
                before = meals[p]
                table.dine(p, pick, eat, drop)
                with guard:
                    if meals[p] != before + 1:
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} ate {meals[p] - before} times in one dine call")
                    if p in (holder[forks[0]], holder[forks[1]]):
                        fail(f"philosopher {p} left the table holding a fork")

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=philosopher, args=(p, random.Random(rng.random()))) for p in range(n)]
        rng.shuffle(threads)
        for t in threads:
            t.start()
        for t in threads:
            t.join()
        out.append(" ".join(map(str, meals)))
    print("\n".join(out))

problem.title: 有界阻塞队列

en.title: Bounded Blocking Queue
en.description:
Implement `BoundedBlockingQueue`, a first-in first-out queue holding at most capacity items, shared by several producer threads and several consumer threads:

- `put(x)`: if the queue is full, block until there is room, then append x at the tail.
- `take()`: if the queue is empty, block until there is an item, then remove and return the head.
- The queue never holds more than capacity items, and items come out in the order they went in, none lost and none twice.

Build it yourself from a lock and condition variables (or semaphores), not from a ready-made blocking queue: Python's `queue.Queue`, Java's `ArrayBlockingQueue` or any other `BlockingQueue`, and Go's buffered channels are all off limits. A plain `deque`, array or slice is fine for storing the items. Do not wait with `sleep` or a polling loop.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `BoundedBlockingQueue(capacity)` | The most items the queue may hold |
| `put(x)` | Wait while full, then append at the tail |
| `take()` | Wait while empty, then remove and return the head |

Each round runs some producer and consumer threads, started in a random order. The driver randomly yields or sleeps briefly around every call, and some consumers start late on purpose so the queue fills up. It keeps its own count of what went in and came out, and reports a problem the moment it sees one. The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines holds four numbers capacity, P, C and k: the round has P producers and C consumers, and producer i (counting from 0) puts the k numbers i·k + 1 to i·k + k in that order. The C consumers take all P·k numbers between them, each a fixed number of times.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100, 1 ≤ capacity ≤ 5, 1 ≤ P, C ≤ 3, 1 ≤ k ≤ 60, and 0 ≤ seed < 2^31.
en.output:
For a round in which every number comes out, one line with two numbers: how many items came out (P·k) and their sum.

As soon as the driver finds a problem, it prints one more line after those already printed, round k: followed by what went wrong, and stops. The problems are the queue went over its capacity of c, take() returned x, which was never put, x was taken twice, x came out after y, though it was put first (one producer's numbers came out of order), and only a of b items came out.
en.explanation: The second round has capacity 1: two producers put 1 2 3 and 4 5 6, and two consumers take 3 numbers each. With capacity 1, every put has to wait for the previous item to be taken. All 6 numbers come out and add up to 21, so the line is 6 21.
hints: One lock and two condition variables: producers wait on not_full and consumers on not_empty. After a put, wake one consumer; after a take, wake one producer.
Always wait inside a while loop: by the time a thread wakes up, another thread may already have changed the condition.
With semaphores: slots starts at capacity and items at 0, plus a lock guarding the queue itself. Take the semaphore before the lock; the other order deadlocks.

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `BoundedBlockingQueue(capacity)` | 最多容纳的元素个数 |
| `put(x)` | 满时等待，然后放到队尾 |

                        fail(f"take() returned {x}, which was never put")
                    if taken[x]:
                        fail(f"{x} was taken twice")
                    p = (x - 1) // k
                    if x < last[p]:
                        fail(f"{x} came out after {last[p]}, though it was put first")
                    taken[x], last[p] = True, x
                    count["done"] += 1
                    count["sum"] += x

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=producer, args=(i, random.Random(rng.random()))) for i in range(producers)]
        threads += [threading.Thread(target=consumer, args=(j, random.Random(rng.random()))) for j in range(consumers)]
        rng.shuffle(threads)
        for t in threads:
            t.start()
        for t in threads:
            t.join()
        if count["done"] != total:
            fail(f"only {count['done']} of {total} items came out")
        out.append(f"{total} {count['sum']}")
    print("\n".join(out))


main()

problem.title: 读写锁

en.title: Read-Write Lock
en.description:
Implement a read-write lock `RWLock`:

- Any number of threads may hold the read lock at once, as long as nobody holds the write lock.
- The write lock is exclusive: while a thread holds it, nobody else may read or write.
- A thread that cannot get the lock blocks until it can; do not wait with `sleep` or a polling loop.

Build it yourself from a mutex and a condition variable rather than a ready-made read-write lock: Java's `ReentrantReadWriteLock` and `StampedLock`, Go's `sync.RWMutex` and C++'s `std::shared_mutex` are all off limits. Whether waiting writers get priority is up to you; the judge does not check it.

| Method | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `acquire_read()` | Take the read lock once no writer holds the lock |
| `release_read()` | Release the read lock |
| `acquire_write()` | Take the write lock once there are no readers and no writer |
| `release_write()` | Release the write lock |

In Java and Go the methods are camel-cased (`acquireRead`, `AcquireRead` and so on). Each round makes a new `RWLock` and is one of three kinds:

- `mix`: reader and writer threads share some data. A writer adds its value to two variables in two steps with a pause in between, and a reader reads the two variables at different moments; if they differ, it has seen a half-done write. The driver also counts the readers and writers inside the lock directly.
- `share`: readers only. Each reader that gets the read lock waits until every reader has it before releasing. If read locks cannot be shared, say because the lock is a plain mutex, the round times out and fails.
- `hold`: the driver takes the write lock itself and starts a reader and a writer trying to get in; neither may get in within 0.1 s. Then the driver takes the read lock and starts a writer, which must also stay out.

The judge only compares output, so building the answer without threads would also pass, but it would skip the concurrency this problem is about.
en.input:
The first line holds a random seed and the number of rounds R. Each of the next R lines is one round, of one of three kinds:

mix r w ops v1 … vw: r readers and w writers, each doing ops operations; the i-th writer adds vi to the data each time.

share n: n readers hold the read lock together.

hold: while the driver holds the lock, other threads must stay out.

1 ≤ R ≤ 100; in a mix round r + w ≤ 8, 1 ≤ ops ≤ 12 and 1 ≤ vi ≤ 9; in a share round 2 ≤ n ≤ 8; and 0 ≤ seed < 2^31.
en.output:
One line for each round that ends cleanly: the final value of the data for a mix round, n for a share round, and held for a hold round.

As soon as the driver finds a problem, it prints one more line after those already printed, round k: followed by what went wrong, and stops. The problems are a reader got in while a writer held the lock, a writer got in while another thread held the lock, a reader saw a half-done write (a and b), n readers could not hold the read lock at the same time, a thread got in while the write lock was held, and a writer got in while a read lock was held.
en.explanation: The third round has 2 readers and 2 writers doing 3 operations each, and the writers' values are 4 and 5, so the data ends at 3 × (4 + 5) = 27. As long as writers exclude each other and the readers, no reader ever sees a half-done write.
hints: Guard a few counts with one mutex: how many readers hold the lock and whether a writer is writing. Readers wait for "no writer"; writers wait for "no readers and no writer".
When the last reader leaves, or a writer releases, wake every waiter (notify_all, signalAll, Broadcast): a whole batch of readers may be able to get in together.
With a steady stream of readers, a writer might wait forever. Count the waiting writers and make new readers wait while there are any, and writers no longer starve.

problem.description:
实现读写锁 `RWLock`：

- 读锁可以被多个线程同时持有，前提是没有线程持有写锁。
- 写锁是独占的：持有写锁时，其他线程既不能读也不能写。
- 拿不到锁的线程要阻塞等待，直到条件满足；不要用 `sleep` 或空转循环。

请用互斥锁加条件变量自己实现，不要直接用现成的读写锁：Java 的 `ReentrantReadWriteLock`、`StampedLock`，Go 的 `sync.RWMutex`，C++ 的 `std::shared_mutex` 都不行。是否让等待中的写者优先，由你决定，判题不检查。

| 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `acquire_read()` | 获取读锁：等到没有写者持有锁 |
| `release_read()` | 释放读锁 |
| `acquire_write()` | 获取写锁：等到既没有读者也没有写者 |
| `release_write()` | 释放写锁 |

Java 和 Go 里方法名是驼峰形式（`acquireRead`、`AcquireRead` 等）。每轮新建一个 `RWLock`，有三种轮次：

- `mix`：若干读者和写者线程并发访问一份数据。写者把自己的值分两步加到两个变量上，中间会停一下；读者分两次读这两个变量，看到不相等就说明读到了写了一半的数据。驱动还会直接统计锁内的读者和写者人数。
- `share`：只有读者。每个读者拿到读锁后，要等所有读者都拿到读锁才释放。读锁不能共享（比如直接用一把普通互斥锁）时，这一轮会超时失败。
- `hold`：驱动自己先拿写锁，再启动一个读者和一个写者去抢，0.1 秒内谁都不能进来；然后驱动拿读锁，再让一个写者去抢，同样不能进来。

判题只比较输出，所以绕开线程直接拼出答案也能通过，但那样就没有练到并发。
problem.input:
第一行是随机种子 seed 和轮数 R。接下来 R 行，每行一轮，是以下三种之一：

mix r w ops v1 … vw：r 个读者、w 个写者，每人做 ops 次操作；第 i 个写者每次把 vi 加到数据上。

share n：n 个读者同时持有读锁。

hold：驱动持锁时，其他线程要被挡在外面。

1 ≤ R ≤ 100，mix 轮里 r + w ≤ 8、1 ≤ ops ≤ 12、1 ≤ vi ≤ 9，share 轮里 2 ≤ n ≤ 8，0 ≤ seed < 2^31。
problem.output:
每轮顺利结束时输出一行：mix 轮输出数据的最终值，share 轮输出 n，hold 轮输出 held。

驱动一旦发现问题，就在已经输出的行后面再输出一行 round k: 加上问题描述，然后立即结束。问题包括：a reader got in while a writer held the lock、a writer got in while another thread held the lock、a reader saw a half-done write (a and b)、n readers could not hold the read lock at the same time、a thread got in while the write lock was held、a writer got in while a read lock was held。
problem.explanation: 第三轮有 2 个读者和 2 个写者，每人 3 次操作，两个写者的值是 4 和 5，所以数据最终是 3 × (4 + 5) = 27。只要写者之间、写者与读者之间正确互斥，读者就不会看到写了一半的数据。
hints: 用一把互斥锁保护几个计数：持有读锁的读者数、是否有写者在写。读者等“没有写者”，写者等“没有读者也没有写者”。
最后一个读者释放读锁、或者写者释放写锁时，用 notify_all（signalAll、Broadcast）唤醒等待者，因为可能有一批读者可以一起进入。
读者源源不断时，写者可能一直等不到。记录“等待中的写者”数量，让新来的读者等写者先走，就能避免写者饿死。

import threading


class RWLock:
    """读写锁 / Read-write lock: many readers at once, or a single writer alone."""

    def __init__(self):
        pass  # TODO: 锁、条件变量和计数 / a lock, a condition variable and some counts

    def acquire_read(self):
        pass  # TODO: 没有写者时进入 / get in once no writer holds the lock

    def release_read(self):
        pass  # TODO

    def acquire_write(self):
        pass  # TODO: 没有读者也没有写者时进入 / get in once nobody else holds the lock

    def release_write(self):
        pass  # TODO


# —— 以下驱动代码请勿修改 / Driver code below: do not modify ——
import os
import random
import sys
import threading
import time


def pause(rng):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.4:
        time.sleep(0)
    elif r < 0.45:
        time.sleep(0.00005)


def main():
    it = iter(sys.stdin.read().split())
    rng = random.Random(int(next(it)))
    sys.setswitchinterval(1e-5)
    out, failing = [], threading.Lock()
    for r in range(int(next(it))):
        kind, lock, guard = next(it), RWLock(), threading.Lock()

        def fail(message):
            failing.acquire()
            sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out + [f"round {r + 1}: {message}"]) + "\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
            os._exit(0)

        def run(workers):
            threads = [threading.Thread(target=work, args=(random.Random(rng.random()),)) for work in workers]
            rng.shuffle(threads)
            for t in threads:
                t.start()
            for t in threads:
                t.join()

        if kind == "hold":
            # While the driver holds the lock, threads that try to get in must stay out.
            entered = []

            def probe(acquire, release):
                def work():
                    acquire()
                    entered.append(1)
                    release()

                thread = threading.Thread(target=work)
                thread.start()
                return thread

            def kept_out(message):
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 0.1
                while not entered and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    time.sleep(0.001)
                if entered:
                    fail(message)

            lock.acquire_write()
            waiting = [probe(lock.acquire_read, lock.release_read), probe(lock.acquire_write, lock.release_write)]
            kept_out("a thread got in while the write lock was held")
            lock.release_write()
            for t in waiting:
                t.join()
            entered.clear()
            lock.acquire_read()
            waiting = probe(lock.acquire_write, lock.release_write)
            kept_out("a writer got in while a read lock was held")
            lock.release_read()
            waiting.join()
            out.append("held")
        elif kind == "share":
            # Every reader must be able to hold the read lock at once.
            n = int(next(it))
            together = threading.Barrier(n)

            def reader(own):
                pause(own)
                lock.acquire_read()
                try:
                    together.wait(timeout=2)
                except threading.BrokenBarrierError:
                    fail(f"{n} readers could not hold the read lock at the same time")
                lock.release_read()

            run([reader] * n)
            out.append(str(n))
        else:
            readers, writers, ops = int(next(it)), int(next(it)), int(next(it))
            values = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(writers)]
            data = [0, 0]  # a writer adds its value to both; a reader must never see them differ
            inside = {"readers": 0, "writers": 0}

            def reader(own):
                for _ in range(ops):
                    pause(own)
                    lock.acquire_read()
                    with guard:
                        if inside["writers"]:
                            fail("a reader got in while a writer held the lock")
                        inside["readers"] += 1
                    a = data[0]
                    pause(own)
                    b = data[1]
                    if a != b:
                        fail(f"a reader saw a half-done write ({a} and {b})")
                    with guard:
                        inside["readers"] -= 1
                    lock.release_read()

            def writer(v):
                def work(own):
                    for _ in range(ops):
                        pause(own)
                        lock.acquire_write()
                        with guard:
                            if inside["writers"] or inside["readers"]:
                                fail("a writer got in while another thread held the lock")
                            inside["writers"] += 1
                        a = data[0]
                        pause(own)
                        data[0] = a + v
                        pause(own)
                        data[1] += v
                        with guard:
                            inside["writers"] -= 1
                        lock.release_write()

                return work

            run([reader] * readers + [writer(v) for v in values])
            out.append(str(data[0]))
    print("\n".join(out))


main()
